This is the Cursor twin of `.claude/bkit-cloud.md`: the **same bkit cloud environment**,
built by a different mechanic. Cursor **Cloud Agents**
bake the toolchain (vale, gh, jq, python3, corepack pnpm) into `.cursor/Dockerfile`,
and run the per-snapshot install from `.cursor/environment.json` — both ship in the
repo, nothing to paste. The only thing you add in the dashboard is the **secrets**
below.

## 1 · Where

Cloud Agents dashboard → **https://cursor.com/dashboard/cloud-agents** → your
environment → **Secrets** tab. (Secrets are scoped per environment — one set does not
leak to another. See `.bkit/cloud.md` § Sharing across repos → Cursor.)

## 2 · Secrets

Add **each** line below as a secret (Name = the key, Value = the value). Set the
**type** per the rule below — for bkit's tokens use **Runtime Secret**:

- **Runtime Secret** — loaded into the agent's environment **but redacted from the
  agent's transcript/commits**. Use this for every token below: MCP servers, `gh`,
  `pnpm`, and `bkit-preflight.sh` read them from the process env, while the agent never
  sees the raw value. (Still visible to a human in the Terminal — that's expected.)
- **Environment Variable** — visible to the agent; only for non-secret config.
- **Build Secret** — Docker-build-time only; not needed unless you move the
  `pnpm` auth into the Dockerfile (bkit runs it in `environment.json` `install`).

```dotenv
@@CLOUD_ENV_VARS@@
```

@@CLOUD_ENV_NOTES@@

- `GITHUB_ISSUE_ID` (GitHub tracker) / `LINEAR_ISSUE_ID` (Linear tracker) are injected

- `BKIT_GH_TOKEN` PAT permissions (fine-grained for one owner, classic across owners) are documented in `.bkit/cloud.md`
  § `BKIT_GH_TOKEN` — token permissions (identical scope to the Claude side).
- Secrets are encrypted at rest and in transit and scoped to the environment.

## 3 · Toolchain (in-repo — nothing to paste)

The base image bakes the **same tools at the same versions as the Claude setup
script** — vale 3.9.1, gh, jq, python3, corepack-pinned pnpm — so both clouds run an
identical bkit toolchain:

- `.cursor/Dockerfile` — image build, your copy of the template (keep its
  `bkit toolchain` section as shipped; set Node major / Playwright / extra apt deps
  outside it).
- `.cursor/environment.json` — per-snapshot `install` (`pnpm install
  --frozen-lockfile` + `vale sync`), the analogue of Claude's
  `.claude/hooks/bkit-cloud-bootstrap.sh`. (`install` / `start` / `terminals` are the
  environment.json fields Cursor runs.)

After changing either, run `pnpm bkit install` and commit — the first session
rebuilds the image; later sessions reuse cached layers.
